# .github/

GitHub-specific configuration for the Rasik Studio repository.

## Contents

- `workflows/` — GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline definitions
- `CODEOWNERS` — code ownership assignments (when added)
- `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` — PR checklist template (when added)
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` — issue templates (when added)
- `dependabot.yml` — automated dependency update configuration

## Rules

Do not put application source code here. This directory is exclusively for GitHub platform configuration.
